messages:
noah.kim: hey team! first-week question: i need to know who to ping for (A) short-term access to the dedicated GPU cluster for a smoke test, (B) approval to run a small costy benchmark (<= $50), (C) hardware badge for office door, and (D) who mentors new infra hires. trying to avoid making a dozen tickets if possible.
rachel-ids: welcome @noah.kim! quick map: GPU cluster access -> eng-platform for resource tenancy (cc @ben-plat), cost approvals under $100 can go via the infra-costs Slack channel and finance will auto-approve if you include a cost estimate & duration, badge requests -> onsite ops (use the badge request form: https://redwood.internal/forms/badge), mentor program -> Dev Mentorship Slack (DM mentor-match bot to get paired).
ben-plat: hi @noah.kim I can grant short-term access. we usually create a scoped role: `gpu_short_term` with 4h ttl. If you paste your workstation IP and job name I can add it now. For benchmarks, tag the PR and include a cost estimate in the infra-costs thread. Example snippet for the infra-costs message:
```
Cost request: benchmark-bert-small
Estimated cost: $42
Duration: 2 hours (staging cluster)
Reason: latency profiling for feature X
```
That usually gets routed to finance auto-approve.
cara-security: reminder: any access to customer data or PII requires an approved data access form and manager sign-off before we provision. For GPU-only compute with synthetic data you9re fine. Also ensure your SSO + 2FA are set; no access without them.
infra-queue-bot: Badge / hardware requests: create ticket in ONSITE queue with field `employee_id` and `access_level`. SSO: Incomplete - 2FA required.
onsite-ops: badge folks here. "+1" to using the badge form. If you need the badge same-day, put "expedite: yes" and we try to meet you at reception. We'll need your photo and manager approval.
mentor-match: Hi @noah.kim! We pair new infra hires with a mentor for the first 8 weeks. To opt-in DM me `join mentor` and include your timezone + two topics you want mentorship on (e.g., kernel tuning, observability).
noah.kim: thanks all 12 i'll DM @ben-plat my IP + job name. @cara-security noted on DPA. i'll submit the badge form and put expedite=yes. last Q: who signs off on long-lived service accounts for scheduled inference jobs?
ben-plat: long-lived service accounts (>30d) need platform lead + security approval. submit a ticket to `INFRA-SVC-ACCTS` with intended scopes and rotate plan. short-lived tokens we can generate via `redwood auth create --scope=compute:run --ttl=30d --note="bench-run-1"` but still requires a ticket.
noah.kim: perfect. appreciate the map and fast responses :thumbsup:
